d=open('SctG3_4i4.bin','rb').read()
def score(off,n,rel):
    ok=0;tot=0
    for k in range(0,n-3,4):
        b0,b1,b2,b3=d[off+k],d[off+k+1],d[off+k+2],d[off+k+3]

    tot_ok=sum(x[1] for x in b); tot_q=sum(x[2] for x in b)
